alt.en: A large indigo cloud floats above a gray floor at the center. On the left, a dashed orange line carrying two packets runs from an upright phone up into the cloud. On the right, a dotted indigo arrow runs from the cloud to a standing certificate with an indigo seal.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央上方悬浮着一朵大型靛蓝色云。左侧，一条带两个数据包的橙色虚线从直立的手机向上延伸到云中；右侧，一条靛蓝色点线箭头从云指向一张带靛蓝色印章的立式证书。

caption.en: Illustration: a durable-execution runtime, shown as a cloud, receives an outside reply from a phone and writes completed steps to a record that replay can reuse after a crash. It does not depict a tested deployment, Temporal or Cloudflare Workflows, and it does not show that recovery works as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：以云代表的持久执行运行时接收来自手机的外部回复，并把已完成的步骤写入记录，供崩溃后重放时复用。图中并非经过测试的实际部署，也不代表 Temporal 或 Cloudflare Workflows，更不表明恢复机制如文中所述那样有效。
